name: Jet Exhaust Afterburner
description: This is part of a set of modular jet engine components. Thrust will be produced at the back of the exhaust proportional to the internal RPS of the engine. Additional thrust is produced when the afterburner is active, at the cost of increased fuel consumption.
shortDescription: A jet engine exhaust that can burn additional fuel for increased output.

logicNodes.label: Thrust Spoiler
logicNodes.description: The air flow spoiler for reducing effective thrust from the exhaust. Takes value 0 (no reduction in thrust) to 1 (total reduction in thrust).

logicNodes.label: Air Pressure
logicNodes.description: The pressure of air into the exhaust.

logicNodes.label: Temperature
logicNodes.description: The temperature of air into the exhaust.

logicNodes.label: Fuel
logicNodes.description: Jet fuel input to the afterburner.
